newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SWIMMING-AUSTRALIA BREAK 4X100 MEDLEY RELAY WORLD RECORD.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-AUSTRALIA BREAK 4X100 MEDLEY RELAY WORLD RECORD.

text.p: Australia broke their own men's world short-course 4x100 metres medley relay record at the world short-course swimming championships on Thursday.
The Australian quartet of Adrian Radley, Phil Rogers, Geoff Huegill and Michael Klim clocked three minutes 30.66 seconds.
The previous mark of 3:30.91 was set by Radley, Ryan Mitchell, Huegill and Klim in Melbourne on December 22 last year.
